rationale: Identity was properly verified via full name and zip, and the agent worked only on the authenticated user’s orders. The watch modification on order #W4219264 was handled correctly with explicit confirmation and accurate tool-supported outcomes. However, there are two policy breaches: (1) The agent updated the shipping address on pending order #W6729841 without first stating the exact change and obtaining explicit user confirmation; (2) The agent submitted the exchange for the delivered air purifier on order #W3445693 without explicit confirmation of the exact change and price difference. Additionally, the agent stated that an email with return instructions would be sent despite no tool evidence provided. These confirmation lapses and the unsupported statement violate the policy, so the conversation does not meet the pass bar.
